bluetooth_confirm.title: Roof hood found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add the roof hood ({name})?

pair.title: Pair roof hood
pair.description: Enter the PIN of the roof hood. Leave empty if none is needed. If the hood is already paired with this Bluetooth adapter, tick "Skip pairing".

reconfigure.title: Re-pair roof hood
reconfigure.description: Enter the PIN of the roof hood. Leave empty if none is needed. If the hood is already paired with this Bluetooth adapter, tick "Skip pairing".

error.invalid_pin: The PIN may only contain digits (max. 6).
error.not_in_range: Roof hood not in range. Switch it on and move closer to the Bluetooth adapter.
error.proxy_not_supported: Pairing is only possible via a local Bluetooth adapter (e.g. USB stick), not via a Bluetooth proxy.
error.agent_failed: PIN handling could not be set up (BlueZ/D-Bus not reachable).
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check the PIN and make sure no other device (phone, Raspberry Pi) is connected to the roof hood.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the roof hood.
